t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes are in pairs and if you find you don't get good points, pivot to another pair

vb_textbox.text: The previous participant advised that gnomes are in pairs. Find which one works best out of the pair and go with that gnome each time. If this doesn't work, pivot strategy immediately. I personally found that going with the brightest coloured gnome gave me good results.
